questions.stem: What is the correct order of the stages of labour?

options.text: Delivery of baby, dilation of cervix, delivery of placenta
Delivery of placenta, dilation of cervix, delivery of baby
Dilation of cervix, delivery of baby, delivery of placenta
Dilation of cervix, delivery of placenta, delivery of baby

questions.explanation: Labour occurs in three stages: first the cervix dilates, then the baby is delivered through the vagina by contractions, and finally the placenta (afterbirth) is expelled.
